disposition_reason: Original flame AAS measurements of Pb, Cd, Ni and five essential metals in gizzard, head and muscle of farm-raised and free-range chickens in Abuja.

study.design: Survey of farm-raised and free-range chicken parts with risk assessment
study.origin: Poultry farms and village (free-range) households, Gwagwalada Area Council, Abuja FCT, Nigeria
study.market: Poultry from farms; local chickens bought from residents
study.method: Flame AAS (air-acetylene) after HNO3 hot-plate digestion of oven-dried tissue
study.qa: Reagent blank carried through; triplicate digestion; no CRM or recovery reported

controls.control: Free-range (local) chicken vs farm-raised poultry chicken
controls.outcome: Muscle Pb 4.28 (poultry) vs 3.45 µg/g DW (local); Cd 0.58 in poultry gizzard vs ND in all local parts

controls.control: Edible part choice (muscle vs gizzard vs head)
controls.outcome: Poultry Pb: muscle 4.28, gizzard 3.07, head ND µg/g DW

unresolved: No LOD, CRM or recovery data; flame AAS lead values of 3-4 µg/g dry weight in muscle are high.
Samples of each part were merged before analysis, so the n values (50 and 10) are not independent replicates.
Arsenic and mercury were not measured.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Hazard index for poultry chicken exceeds 1 (authors); THQ < 1 for individual metals
